description.description: A person demonstrates a pizza box life hack by breaking down a large pizza box into a smaller storage container. The video begins with several pizza slices stacked to one side of the cardboard box. The person then proceed to tear the perforated edges of the box base, removing the large flat surface. Finally, they fold the remaining cardboard along pre-cut lines to create a compact, lidded box that perfectly fits the left-over stacked pizza slices.
